qualification.authorized_execution: Isolated local Splunk Enterprise lab and TA-grounded synthetic events
qualification.release: Draft PR until required deployment qualification and independent Astra review pass

identity.meraki_authority: organizationId plus networkId; native client key is canonical MAC
identity.catalyst_authority: Verified controller/account authority; native client identifier or canonical MAC
identity.event_time: Explicit source timestamp; never substitute collection time for historical attachment
identity.collection_time: Preserve separately when supplied; indexed receipt time is separately identified
identity.attachment: Time-bounded source evidence; Catalyst snapshot validity begins at first indexed receipt, never at controller lastUpdatedTime; Meraki association correlation requires compatible MAC/IP, scope and time. Missing, stale, simultaneous conflicting or capped history remains unresolved.
identity.history: Stable event identity for replay; preserve event ordering and moves; never silently bridge unavailable history or capped intervals
identity.persistence: New sources use source-qualified keys and versioned records; preserve existing source keys and optional network_history contract; stage incompatible derived changes in new collections/indexes before cutover
identity.replay: Collapse identical Catalyst payloads to earliest receipt; later receipts update health only and cannot renew attachment validity. Without a source poll ID or collector timestamp, a repeated unchanged poll cannot be distinguished from replay. Meraki event identity uses only observed fields.

routing.rule: Explicit unambiguous source-to-scope mapping is required for new source correlation
routing.domain: Preserve actual exporter domain/VPN/VRF when present; one exporter with multiple domains requires distinct mappings
routing.unmapped: Expose incomplete evidence; do not correlate through shared default scope
routing.kubernetes: Retain cluster identity in observers and hosts; per-cluster forwarding settings; no new cluster silently inherits a conflicting fleet-wide setting
routing.registration_key: SHA-256 of a JSON array of source, source_authority, domain_kind, observation_domain_present, observation_domain_id, vpn_id and routing_domain. Cast each dimension inline with tostring(coalesce(field, empty string)) inside json_array. Missing domain differs from zero. Exactly one explicit mapped row with duplicate_count=1, scope, cluster and a supported profile is required; ambiguity and missing fields fail closed.

topology.device_key: Source authority plus native device identifier; names and addresses are aliases with ambiguity detection
topology.rule: Physical adjacency is not a packet route; inventory shortest paths and tunnel availability cannot assert connection transit; missing links stay gaps

traffic.campus_and_meraki: Standard FNF/IPFIX only; never apply Catalyst SD-WAN proprietary fields indiscriminately
traffic.sdwan: Only fields verified in the 4.0.0 mapping and selected exporter template
traffic.counters: Keep exporter, interfaces, direction, observation point, domain and counter/sampling semantics; unknown metrics are not authoritative; ingress/egress views cannot be summed as independent traffic
traffic.records: Flow record counts are distinct from connection counts
traffic.nat: Without actual translation/backend evidence, keep an unresolved boundary

presentation.graph_schema: Keep old schema_version 1 snapshots readable; optional typed additions only unless a dual reader is implemented
presentation.wireless_label: Correlated from association and flow evidence

demo.catalyst: Wired Catalyst client, separate SD-WAN traffic observation, Cilium application on ACI
demo.meraki: Bridged MR wireless client, supported MS390 IPFIX observation, distinct Cilium application on NX-OS
demo.applications: Distinct clusters and scoped service identities; collected Pod/Node/Service/EndpointSlice and OTel spans; Hubble TO_ENDPOINT for inbound backend attribution
demo.reference_forwarding: Source-preserving LoadBalancer externalTrafficPolicy Local, native routing/BGP, L2 announcements disabled; no fabricated inbound Tetragon processConnect
demo.fixtures: Combined dataset plus existing scenarios; capture normalized graph/topology/catalog/scope/Find fixtures from implemented Splunk searches

ownership.root: Architecture, package manifest, lab harness/lifecycle, integration/capture, migration/recovery coordination, release qualification and final verification
ownership.vendor_packages: Downloaded archives remain static research data; lab installs only explicitly selected configuration plus the separate vendor app. Never rebundle into Atlas or execute downloaded input scripts during research.

persistence.legacy: Existing v1 writers, rollup IDs and historical records stay in adm_summary. Existing KV keys are preserved.
persistence.staging: New network client history version1 is additive. Changed flow semantics write contract_version2 to separately provisioned adm_summary_v2 via a disabled-by-default v2 writer.
persistence.cutover: Explicit, validated reader/writer transition with configuration backup and bounded handoff; never point the legacy v1 writer at the v2 index. Restore both reader configuration and writer states for rollback; retain original data.
